executed_actions: 7D OSC_POSE controller commands: xyz translation increments, three rotation-control components, gripper; not world displacement in metres or measured orientation error. Controller scaling not inferred from shape.
predicted_chunks: de-normalized action-space predictions,8x7 per inference; gripper raw0close/1open; deployed -sign(2*g-1), +1close/-1open; checked elementwise all400.
position_units: metres in simulator world; all after action; body and geometry bowl centers checked equal for all records.
states: 92D serialized simulator vector; post-action; not decoded as arbitrary qpos offsets.
video: 2.5fps at chunk inference, pre-action controls0,8,...; terminal result may occur after final video frame.
initial: frozen protocol arrays independently hashed; never replaced by first post-action row.
lift: existing3cm proxy, baseline reconstructed from max(body_z)-recorded max_lift solely to audit index; not grasp truth and not required for task success.
pose_inference: No rotation-command difference is called actual angular error; no force, friction, slip, grasp stability or training coverage claim.
